00051 #define DLL_CALLCONV __stdcall
00052 // The following ifdef block is the standard way of creating macros which make exporting 
00053 // from a DLL simpler. All files within this DLL are compiled with the FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00054 // symbol defined on the command line. this symbol should not be defined on any project
00055 // that uses this DLL. This way any other project whose source files include this file see 
00056 // DLL_API functions as being imported from a DLL, wheras this DLL sees symbols
00057 // defined with this macro as being exported.
00058 #ifdef FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00059 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllexport)
00060 #else
00061 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllimport)
00062 #endif // FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00063 #endif // FREEIMAGE_LIB || !WIN32
